title: Better Chairs
description: A datapack that adds sitting functionality to mimic chairs.
body:
# Better Chairs v1.0.0 Stand on a stair or a bottom slab block and position yourself so that you are in the block.
After positioning yourself correctly, right-click, and you should now be in a sitting position. If you wish to sit at your current position regardless of the block you are on,
simply use `/function main:force_sit` to seat yourself automatically. Chairs will despawn if you move more than 5 blocks away from them.
Therefore, you must repeat the steps above to sit in different chairs.
